action.details: Uses AVSpeechSynthesizer on this Mac. Starting the action stops any speech previously started by this action and speaks the new selection using the current system voice.
action.exampleInput: ActionClip can read this sentence aloud.
action.name: Say
action.privacySummary: Speech synthesis runs locally with the macOS system voice. The selected text does not leave your Mac.
action.requirements: A macOS system voice must be available. Voice preferences are managed by macOS.
action.summary: Speak the selected text with the macOS system voice.
